QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_1

question.text: Mr. Ramesh Iyer, fund manager of 'Lotus Growth Category II AIF', receives a 2-page summary of a FinTech company directly from the investment banker appointed by that company. This document, sent to multiple prospective funds without any prior NDA being signed, is BEST described as which of the following?

explanation.text: The Logic: A Teaser (also called a Flier) is a brief 1-3 page summary of the company that investment bankers send to prospective funds without any NDA. Only if the fund shows interest does it sign an NDA to receive the fuller CIM/IM. PPM is the AIF's own offer document to its investors; PIM is an internal document the fund's IC reviews before term sheet. The Trap: CIM is the full information memorandum that comes AFTER NDA is signed — not sent blind. PPM is confused because both are 'memoranda', but PPM is the AIF's document, not the investee's. PIM is internal to the AIF manager.
